subject: Security intake & procurement alignment for Aurea Health - next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake & procurement alignment for Aurea Health - next steps

Hi Priya — great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

Call highlights:
- Aurea is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization and clinical notes search.
- Primary non-functional priorities: latency for live summarization, data residency, and SOC2 evidence.
- Procurement path: standard SOW + PO; legal suggests a short review of security annex before sign.

Action items / asks (can you confirm?):
1) Economic buyer / exec sponsor (name + email) so we can loop them into pricing conversations.
2) Procurement contact (for PO / contract intake).
3) Security questionnaire — please attach your questionnaire if you have one (we can start intake in parallel).
4) Systems in scope: you mentioned the customer portal and embeddings service — please confirm exact hosts and whether third-party vendors (CDN, analytics) are in scope.

Attached is a short kickoff checklist we use to speed the intake (Redwood-Security-Kickoff-Checklist.pdf). If you can share the Aurea questionnaire and a preferred time for a 30m security intake next week, we’ll get Laura involved to run the evidence collection and Marissa to coordinate implementation timelines.

Proposed meeting windows (PST):
- Tue 7/6 09:00–11:00
- Thu 7/8 13:00–15:00

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments referenced: Redwood-Security-Kickoff-Checklist.pdf
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & procurement alignment for Aurea Health - next steps

Ben / Marissa — thanks for the recap and the checklist. Quick answers below and attaching our questionnaire (Aurea-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx).

1) Economic buyer / exec sponsor: Sanjiv Rao (VP, Security & Compliance) — sanjiv.rao@aureahealth.com. He’ll want a short exec summary and cost ballpark before committing to procurement timelines.

2) Procurement contact: Cara Lim (procure@aureahealth.com) — she handles PO and standard MSAs. Expect a two-week internal review once legal gets a security annex.

3) Questionnaire: attached — primary asks relate to data flows, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS usage, and breach notification timelines.

4) Systems in scope (initial):
- customer-portal.aureahealth.com (user-facing web app)
- api.aureahealth.com (backend API handling PHI tokenization)
- embeddings-store (managed Redis cluster hosted in our us-west-2 VPC)

We do use S3 (aurea-embeddings-prod) and CloudFront; both should be listed as third-party infra in scope. We don’t expect analytics pipeline (batch logs) to be in scope for this phase.

We can do the intake call next Thursday 7/8 at 14:00 PST — Sanjiv will join for the first 15 minutes for exec alignment. Please send a calendar invite with the intake agenda (SOC2 evidence matrix; data flows & network boundaries; timeline for attestation).

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Shah
Director, Product Security | Aurea Health
priya.shah@aureahealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0123

Attachment: Aurea-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aureahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & procurement alignment for Aurea Health - next steps

Priya — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detail. Looping in Laura to run the security intake and evidence collection. Laura, can you own the questionnaire and the evidence matrix? Below is the initial ask list we’ll need to cover on the call and in follow-ups.

Initial evidence / docs we will bring / request:
- Redwood SOC2 Type II (attached: SOC2-Type2-Redwood-2026.pdf) — we’ll share during the call.
- Data flow diagram for the proposed integration (we’ll draft a template; please confirm endpoints).
- KMS practices + key rotation policy (redacted).
- Retention & deletion workflow for embeddings.

Procurement notes for Cara / Sanjiv:
- Typical Redwood path for Dedicated/Hosted: SOW + MSA + security annex. We can provide a short security appendix the legal team can attach to the MSA.
- If you prefer redlines, we can accept early-term signatures to provision demo capacity while legal finalizes commercial terms.

Priya — I’ll send a calendar invite for Thu 7/8 14:00 PST with a 30m agenda and have Laura prepare a checklist-based walkthrough to speed evidence handoff. Ben — I’ll coordinate with Laura on handing off the SOC2 artifacts and the evidence tracker.

—Marissa
